dossier_meta.paper: On Modular Edge Colourings of Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $k$ be a positive integer. For every $0_{k}$-graph $G$ we have $\chi^{\prime}_{k}(G)\leq k+o(k)$.
dossier_meta.context_text: A $0_k$-graph is a graph whose relevant subgraph structure satisfies a $0\pmod{k}$ degree condition. If Conjecture 13 holds, the proof strategy of Theorem 2 can be adapted so that a maximal $0_k$-subgraph $H$ of any graph $G$ is coloured with $\leq k+o(k)$ colours and the remainder (which would then be $(2q(k)-2)$-degenerate) is coloured via Lemma 9, yielding an overall bound approaching $\chi^{\prime}_{k}(G)\leq k+o(k)$ for all graphs.
